sentences.text:
+ Crl.Rev.P. 304/2025
 Radhey Shyam

Through: Mr. Sanjeev Kr. Baliyan, Adv.
 (Dhclsc).
 versus
 State Of Nct Of Delhi And Ors .....

Res 
 Through: Ms. Meenakshi Dahiya, App for
 with Inspector Harnam Singh, Eow and I
 Samaria, Ato, Prem Nagar.
Coram:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AJAY DIGPAUL  ORDER % 07.08.2025 CRL.M.A. 23088/2025 (seeking condonation of delay)
1. For the sufficient cause shown in the application, the same is allowed.
Delay of 128 days in filing the petition is condoned.
2. Accordingly, the instant application stands disposed of.
CRL.M.A. 23090/2025 (seeking condonation of delay in re-filing)
3. For the sufficient cause shown in the application, the same is allowed.
Delay of 90 days in re-filing the petition is condoned.
4. Accordingly, the instant application stands disposed of.
CRL.M.A. 23089/2025 (exemption)
5. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
6. The application stands disposed of.

7. The present petition has been filed by the petitioner under Sections 397/401 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 read with Sections 438/442 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 seeking setting

Learned APP appearing on behalf of the State accepts notice.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, let intimation be sent by the Investigating Officer to respondents no. 2 to 4, informing them that they are entitled to be heard in the present proceedings, for which they may remain present (either in-person or via video-conferencing) or be represented on the next date.
11. List on 15.10.2025.
AJAY DIGPAUL, J AUGUST 7, 2025
